title: DGFT Pushes Back i-CAS-Halal Certification Deadline for Meat Exports to Egypt to February 2027
case_name: DGFT Notification No. 48/2026-27 amending the transition timeline for mandatory i-CAS-Halal certification of specified meat exports to Egypt
citation: DGFT Notification No. 48/2026-27, dated 9 November 2026, amending Notification No. 59/2025-26 as earlier amended by Notification No. 28/2026-27 dated 5 August 2026
card_summary: DGFT has extended, for the second time, the deadline for Indian meat exporters to Egypt to move to mandatory i-CAS-Halal certification. The transition period now runs twelve months from the original 9 February 2026 notification date, pushing the deadline to 9 February 2027. DGFT says this is to let Egyptian certification bodies finish onboarding and accreditation under the scheme. No other export requirement changes.
card_tip: Exporters relying on an older halal certificate for the Egyptian market should track the accreditation status of their certifying body rather than assume the extended deadline removes the need to switch.
verification_notes: AUDIENCE: foreign company / domestic exporter (Indian meat exporters and their Egyptian buyers, both affected by the certification body transition). TARGET QUERY: DGFT halal certification deadline meat exports Egypt extended. DEMAND EVIDENCE: none seen (no search-volume or trending data was seen; picked as a dated, primary regulatory notification with consistent trade-press reporting). Cross-verified across Taxscan, A2Z Taxcorp and World Trade Scanner, which agree on the notification number (48/2026-27), the date (9 November 2026), the subject (i-CAS-Halal certification for specified meat exports to Egypt) and the new deadline (9 February 2027, i.e. twelve months from the original 9 February 2026 date), and that it amends Notification No. 59/2025-26 as earlier amended by Notification No. 28/2026-27 dated 5 August 2026. This is a procedural timeline extension only; it does not change the underlying certification requirement or any other export condition.
